english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the space between two points, especially geographical distance.

exampleSentences.english: The distance between these two places isn't very far.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢兩個地方嘅距離唔算遠。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 go3 dei6 fong1 ge3 keoi5 lei4 m4 syun3 jyun5

english.note: Use this specifically for the measurable distance between two objects.

exampleSentences.english: The space between the two buildings is very short.
exampleSentences.traditional: 兩棟樓之間嘅距離好短。
exampleSentences.jyutping: loeng5 dung3 lau4 zi1 gaan1 ge3 keoi5 lei4 hou2 dyun2

english.note: Use this for the physical distance separating two people or things, rather than the empty space itself.

exampleSentences.english: The interval separating the two buildings is quite large.
exampleSentences.traditional: 兩座大廈之間嘅距離好遠。
exampleSentences.jyutping: loeng5 zo6 daai6 haa6 zi1 gaan1 ge3 keoi5 lei4 hou2 jyun5
